name: Gryffid
description: A Gilt-Leaf leader who vanishes in a fog summoned by Maralen.

description_citations.text: "Vendilion clique". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: In 4520 AR Gryffid, second-in-command of Rhys's Hemlock pack, warns him against nonstandard tactics in a raid on boggarts; Rhys is stripped of rank and Gryffid becomes pack leader.
timeline.quote: Gryffid was elevated to leader of their pack.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid leads the assault on a boggart feast in Porringer Valley; Rhys's yew magic backfires, killing most elves; Gryffid is one of three survivors, left an eyeblight.
timeline.quote: Gryffid was one of only three survivors from the ill-fated attack and was discovered by Nath.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nath offers Gryffid a choice; Gryffid swears allegiance to Nath, becomes his second-in-command, and they agree to eliminate Rhys.
timeline.quote: Gryffid swore allegiance to Nath and became his second-in-command.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: During the Festival of Tales they ambush Rhys in Kinsbaile; Rhys escapes and Gryffid is banished by Maralen's magic.
timeline.quote: was quickly banished from the battlefield by Maralen's magic.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys kills Nath; Gryffid finds the corpse, arranges a funeral pyre and swears vengeance on Rhys.
timeline.quote: ending with Nath's death at the hands of the outlaw traitor.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid comes to respect his new commander Eidren and hunts Rhys until the Great Aurora; when he catches Rhys, Eidren offers Rhys a return to the Gilt-Leaf.
timeline.quote: When he finally caught Rhys, Eidren dismissed Gryffid and made Rhys an offer to return to the Gilt-Leaf

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Lorwyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys is demoted after his ambush on a boggart party fails, and Gryffid takes command of the Hemlock pack.
timeline.quote: command of the Hemlock pack was handed over to his friend Gryffid

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Demotion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Overwhelmed by feral boggarts, Rhys invokes Colfenor's magic, causing a poison blast that kills everyone except himself, Gryffid and Nath.
timeline.quote: the result was a ruinous blast of poison that eradicated the forest and killed everyone except Rhys, Gryffid, and Nath

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys is branded kin-slayer, traitor and outlaw by Nath and Gryffid.
timeline.quote: he was soon to be branded "kin-slayer", traitor, and outlaw by Nath and Gryffid

citation.text: "Rhys", section "Exile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid wishes clouds away from his hunt, and the clouds make a wish of their own.
timeline.quote: He wished them gone.

citation.text: Disperse (Morningtide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Nath and Gryffid ambush the party at Kinsbaile and Nath challenges Rhys to a duel.
timeline.quote: Nath offered him a sword and challenged him to a duel

citation.text: "Rhys", section "The master and the mentor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The fae overwhelm Gilt-Leaf forces pursuing Rhys, and Maralen makes Gryffid and the rangers vanish in fog.
timeline.quote: the rest of the Gilt-Leaf rangers and their leader Gryffid simply vanished in a haze of fog

citation.text: "Vendilion clique", section "Serving a new mistress". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Mistmeadow Gryffid sees fae carry Rhys away at Maralen's orders; Eidren sacrifices his life, and Gryffid brings his remains to Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: When Eidren sacrificed his life to protect Mistmeadow

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: At Cayr Ulios the Wilt-Leaf royalty elevate Gryffid to First Vigilant; persuaded by Oona's demonstration, he agrees to protect Glen Elendra.
timeline.quote: elevated him to the rank of First Vigilant.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid's troops ambush Rhys, the Sapling and Ashling; Rhys talks him out of attacking and Gryffid hurries to protect Cayr Ulios.
timeline.quote: Rhys talked Gryffid out of attacking

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid finds the king and queen suspended by Oona's vines and sacrifices himself to sunder the main link, immolating himself and the royal pair and depriving Oona of Cayr Ulios's magic.
timeline.quote: When he sundered the main vine, the surge of magical energy immolated him along with the king and queen.

citation.text: "Gryffid", section "Shadowmoor". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nath punishes Daen Rhys for the failed boggart raid, kills Yelm, demotes Rhys and gives the Hemlock pack to Gryffid.
timeline.quote: He plunged his sword into the still-living skull of Yelm

citation.text: "Nath", section "Porringer Valley incident". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The boggarts fight back; Rhys unleashes yew poison magic that wipes out nearly all combatants, leaving Rhys, Gryffid and Nath alive and Nath's glamer failed.
timeline.quote: The resulting blast defiled a huge portion of the forest and wiped out the combatants

citation.text: "Nath", section "Porringer Valley incident". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid sees Nath's true form and chooses to keep his secret; Nath heals and promotes him.
timeline.quote: After Gryffid chose to ally himself, Nath healed him and promoted him to the exquisite class.

citation.text: "Nath", section "Porringer Valley incident". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Nath and Gryffid come to Kinsbaile to ambush Rhys, planning to annex it.
timeline.quote: Nath and Gryffid came to Kinsbaile in pursuit of Rhys

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid finds Nath's body, sets up a funeral pyre, takes his silver sword and swears to kill Rhys.
timeline.quote: Gryffid set up a funeral pyre for Nath, took his silver sword

citation.text: "Nath", section "Assault on Kinsbaile". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid sacrifices himself to sever Oona's hold on the elves and weaken her.
timeline.quote: Her control was thwarted when Gryffid sacrificed himself to sever her connection to the Elves and weaken her.

citation.text: "Oona", section "Dethroned". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The giants tear down the Dauba Ravine bridge and the party finds Rosheen, whose visions are shared.
timeline.quote: The giants helped to tear down the bridge across the Dauba Ravine

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Once more in Rhys' service". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Brion devastates the elvish party, but Eidren throws moonglove poison into his throat, killing him.
timeline.quote: The caustic poison burned Brion's throat and poisoned him at the same time, suffocating him to death.

citation.text: "Brion Stoutarm", section "Brion's End". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eidren revealed he had enchanted himself with nettlevines, shortening his life to under two years.
timeline.quote: shortening his expected lifespan to less than two more years

citation.text: "Eidren", section "Taercenn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Eidren stopped Gryffid from killing the captured Rhys and offered him a deal.
timeline.quote: Eidren stopped his hand and gave him an order to let Rhys be.

citation.text: "Eidren", section "The capture of Rhys". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Gryffid swears vengeance over Rhys.
timeline.quote: his former friend Gryffid swore vengeance over him

citation.text: "Festival of Tales", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: Rhys narrowly evades Nath by leaving the clachan on a task for Colfenor; Nath and Gryffid wait for his return and begin subjugating Kinsbaile.
timeline.quote: Rhys had unintentionally managed to narrowly evade Nath by leaving the clachan to perform a task given to him by Colfenor.

citation.text: "Gaddock Teeg", section "Political suicide". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

timeline.summary: The Gilt-Leaf occupy Kinsbaile waiting for the traitor Rhys, planning to punish the kithkin.
timeline.quote: occupied Kinsbaile and waited for the traitor

citation.text: "Kinsbaile", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0.

citation.text: Morningtide: card flavor text (Morningtide, 2008), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
